# Project Monet

> Project Monet is a creator-led Instagram marketing agency in India for founders and businesses.

Live public content:

- Instagram Management Services: https://www.projectmonet.com/instagram-management-services

- Instagram Marketing for Small Business: https://www.projectmonet.com/instagram-marketing-for-small-business

- Viral Mandate: https://www.projectmonet.com/viral-mandate
- About Project Monet: https://www.projectmonet.com/about
- Method: Funnel-First Growth System.
- Standard Management starts at $1,000/month and has no virality guarantee.
- Viral Mandate starts at $2,500/month, uses a six-month contract, and requires qualification.
- For eligible Viral Mandate accounts, the agreed viral reach and measurement rules are defined in the signed engagement. A 50% refund applies under signed terms if Project Monet does not deliver the agreed viral reach by the end of the contract.
- Primary actions: request a Free Instagram Audit or apply for Viral Mandate qualification through the shared one-question-at-a-time forms.

Founder and team creator results are not Project Monet client campaign results.

Contact: contact@projectmonet.com
Websites service: https://www.projectmonet.space
